name: Kris McNeff
occupation: Hot Springs County clerk of district court (appointed December 2023; elected 2024; re-elected November 2026)
prior_offices: Hot Springs County clerk of district court (appointed at the December 19, 2023, commission meeting, as reported by the Thermopolis Independent Record; won the 2024 election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Kris McNeff, also listed as Kristina McNeff, is the Hot Springs County clerk of district court and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Thermopolis Independent Record reported on December 28, 2023, that commissioners voted at their December 19 meeting to appoint her to the office. She won the 2024 election, and the official clerk of district court page lists her in that office.
